title: Hypercontractive moment gap
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a function $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, and real numbers $p,q,\rho,t$, define the hypercontractive moment gap to be the difference between the $q$th power of the affine moment of order $p$ with parameter $1$ and the $p$th power of the affine moment of order $q$ with parameter $\rho$, both evaluated at $X$ and $t$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of affine moment, so its precise meaning cannot be stated from the provided material.
